cards.name: Change to Global Rulers
cards.summary: Toggles the ruler coordinate system between artboard rulers (origin at the active artboard's top-left, so each artboard measures from its own corner) and global rulers (one origin for the whole canvas). The label flips to Change to Artboard Rulers while global rulers are on. Only the ruler and X/Y readouts change; no object moves.
use_for: measuring positions across several artboards from one shared origin
lining up art that spans two artboards (spreads, packaging dielines)
matching coordinates with a spec measured from one fixed corner of the canvas
avoid: per-artboard placement where X/Y should be relative to each artboard: stay on artboard rulers
the rulers are hidden: the switch still changes the X/Y readouts, but show the rulers (View/Rulers/Show Rulers) to see where the origin now sits
